name: multicurrea
summary: This EA is a multi-currency trading system that analyzes multiple currency pairs simultaneously across different timeframes to generate trading signals. It uses a combination of trend and momentum indicators to identify entry opportunities across correlated or diverging currency pairs. The EA manages positions independently for each symbol it monitors.
summary_zh: 这是一个多货币交易系统，同时分析多个货币对在不同周期上的走势以生成交易信号。它结合趋势和动量指标来识别相关或背离货币对的入场机会，并为每个监控的品种独立管理仓位。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用多货币多周期分析策略，通过同时监控多个相关货币对来捕捉跨市场的趋势机会。入场条件基于多个时间周期的趋势方向一致性确认，当短周期和长周期的信号方向一致时触发交易。出场条件包括固定的止盈止损以及趋势反转信号。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位计算方式。资金管理方面设有最大同时持仓数限制和单笔最大风险控制。策略核心思想是通过多货币的联动分析来提高信号的可靠性，避免单一货币对上的假突破。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a multi-currency multi-timeframe analysis strategy, monitoring multiple correlated currency pairs simultaneously to capture cross-market trend opportunities. Entry conditions are based on trend direction consistency confirmation across multiple timeframes, triggering trades when short-term and long-term signals align. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels as well as trend reversal signals. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or account-balance-proportional calculation methods. Money management includes limits on maximum simultaneous positions and per-trade maximum risk control. The core strategy idea is to improve signal reliability through multi-currency correlation analysis, avoiding false breakouts on single currency pairs.
pros: 多货币同时监控提高了信号的可靠性和交易机会的数量
多周期确认机制减少了假信号和假突破的风险
独立的仓位管理和风险控制适合多品种同时运行
止盈止损设置完整，包含移动止损功能
多货币关联分析有助于捕捉跨市场趋势
pros_en: Multi-currency simultaneous monitoring improves signal reliability and increases trading opportunities
Multi-timeframe confirmation mechanism reduces false signals and false breakout risks
Independent position management and risk control suitable for multi-symbol operation
Complete take-profit and stop-loss setup including trailing stop functionality
Multi-currency correlation analysis helps capture cross-market trends
cons: 多货币同时运行可能导致账户风险集中，特别是在高相关性货币对上
策略逻辑较为复杂，参数众多，优化困难且容易过拟合
缺乏动态仓位调整机制，固定手数在不同市场波动下可能不合适
未考虑点差和滑点对多货币交易的综合影响
多品种同时交易对VPS性能和连接稳定性要求较高
cons_en: Multi-currency simultaneous operation may concentrate account risk, especially on highly correlated pairs
Complex strategy logic with many parameters makes optimization difficult and prone to overfitting
Lacks dynamic position sizing mechanism; fixed lots may not suit varying market volatility
Does not account for comprehensive impact of spread and slippage on multi-currency trades
Multi-symbol simultaneous trading demands high VPS performance and connection stability
improvements: 增加货币对相关性过滤，避免在高相关品种上重复开仓
引入动态仓位管理基于ATR或账户风险比例来适应不同市场波动
improvements_en: Add currency pair correlation filtering to avoid duplicate positions on highly correlated symbols
Introduce dynamic position sizing based on ATR or account risk percentage to adapt to different market volatilities

risk_points: 多货币同时持仓可能导致风险集中，尤其是在相关货币对上
固定止损在极端行情下可能因滑点而失效
参数过多可能导致过度优化和曲线拟合
risk_points_en: Multi-currency simultaneous positions may concentrate risk, especially on correlated pairs
Fixed stop-loss may fail due to slippage during extreme market conditions
Too many parameters may lead to over-optimization and curve fitting

summary_en: This EA is a multi-currency trading system that analyzes multiple currency pairs simultaneously across different timeframes to generate trading signals. It uses a combination of trend and momentum indicators to identify entry opportunities across correlated or diverging currency pairs. The EA manages positions independently for each symbol it monitors.
